estimates.name: Testing goodwill for impairment
estimates.t: Our consolidated balance sheet includes significant amounts of goodwill and other intangible assets.
estimates.effect: At June 30, 2026, the combined carrying value of goodwill and other intangible assets, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges, was $7,949.6 million, representing approximately 69% of our total assets.

estimates.name: Required Annual Assessment
estimates.t: The quantitative impairment test requires estimation of the fair value of our reporting units using a weighted average of a discounted cash flow method and a guideline public company method.
